description: NaMgFe₅O₈ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and edges with six equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.36 Å. Mg is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with six equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.07 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.03 Å) and four longer (2.09 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.01 Å) and three longer (2.14 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, and three Fe atoms to form ONaMgFe₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six equivalent ONaMgFe₃ trigonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent OFe₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with six equivalent ONaMgFe₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one OFe₄ trigonal pyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Fe atoms to form distorted OFe₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with nine equivalent ONaMgFe₃ trigonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent OFe₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with three equivalent ONaMgFe₃ trigonal bipyramids.
